event: He climbs the spiral stair slow and lets only his eyes clear the lip of the floor above.

event: A long, dry vaulted hall, its floor strewn with dead climbers' bones and gear.

event: At the far end, in a reddish glow, sits a large still shape with a deep weight of essence.
Unready, he goes back down to the shallows that nearly drowned him, to prepare first.
He channels into Burning Anger and bursts down its length: a raw wave of fire rolls over the water.

Throwing the wave

He drills the wave narrower, throw by throw, until it will tighten no further.

Drilling the wave

event: He pours all his heat into the steel pauldron: it glows orange and will not climb past it.

Holding the heat until he shakes

event: Taking only the two bars, he holds the throat of the stair at the third floor's mouth.
He tolls Cold Revenge against the doorway stone, and the shape at the far end rises and comes.
A slow, huge sentinel of fused rock and slag grinds down the hall, lit from within by heat.
He swings Cold Revenge into a glowing seam; it hisses, but the stone only cracks shallow.

changes.note: The furnace's heat washes over him at close quarters
The full swing into stone

event: His will goes down through the seam and pulls the creature's heat into him, scorching him.

changes.note: Tearing essence from an unwilling creature costs focus

make.axis: The form and yield of the draw.

Ember Siphon pulls heat essence from an object or creature, through a point of contact, into Alan.

The siphon reaches past a physical shell to the essence within.

A cleanly opened wound lets the siphon pull deeper.

event: The System marks it: SKILL — Ember Siphon.
As its slag limb comes down he drops back into the stair; Burning Anger stays at the lip.

changes.note: Chips and cinders from the blow, and the overflow of stolen heat

Giving ground fast and low

event: Too big for the stairmouth, the sentinel jams there, unable to reach him.
He siphons a thin thread across the gap, and the overfilled heat starts to cook him inside.

changes.note: Heat poured into a full vessel scalds him from within

The oven-heat of the stair

Pulling from a dense, active source near the limit of his fire can overflow and burn him.

event: Instead of venting it, he turns the stolen fire inward to burn the weakness out of his flesh.

changes.note: The crude temper burns more than it hardens

A heavy share of his strength burned away

event: The System marks it: SKILL — Ember-Tempered Body.
He drops Cold Revenge, opens both hands, and siphons the sentinel's fire in a torrent.
The glow collapses out of it; the sentinel goes cold and grey and slumps dead in the stair.

changes.note: The torrent of stolen fire scorches him

The fight spends him

event: He drives all three points into Vitality, widening the vessel before he fills it.

He sets three points into Vitality

event: He pours the guardian's fire and Burning Anger's last heat into his body all at once.

changes.from: A rusted iron bar, warm through with the Ember bound into it.
changes.to: A plain rusted iron bar, the Ember once bound in it drawn out and gone.

event: Some of it sets hard and permanent in him; the rest tears back out through his skin.

event: Badly burned at a fifth of his strength, he takes up both bars and turns from the way up.
Down by the brazier, he sets Burning Anger in the coals and Cold Revenge back in the water.
He falls into a deep, flat sleep and wakes with most of his strength back.

His focus refills in sleep
Sleep burns off the exhaustion

event: He pours heat into the plain bar and drives it past orange to an even yellow.

Holding the yellow heat steady

memory.fact: The channel grows stronger with use and with Alan's attunement to Ember.
The channel grows stronger with use and with Alan's attunement to Ember.

After a nap he pushes his own ember straight into the mace's head and makes it stay.

event: In the wreck's heart lies its drained core, a dense cold knot of slag; he takes it.

event: He walks the third floor end to end: dead and still, built around a forge.
From the rotted forge he keeps one iron hammer-head that still rings true.

changes.note: Digging through the forge's wreck

His focus brims
His wind comes back full

event: His sense of the core blurs with the brazier's heat; it reads as still hungry.
